The modular building blocks. Make once, stack into multiple meals — rice that becomes fried rice, fried rice that becomes a dinner with protein on top.

Bone Broth Rice

Clean savory rice, deep chicken-broth backbone — neutral enough to take any sauce, flavorful enough to eat solo.

~175 cal/serving·9g protein/serving·5 min prep + 20 min cook + 10 min rest
5.1g P/100cal
Fried rice baseBowl base (rice + protein + sauce)Stir-fry sideQuick congee (loosen with extra broth + soft egg)Make-ahead meal prep

Spicy Umami Fried Rice

Toasted rice, soft egg, fermented chili heat, deep umami finish. Restaurant-takeout satisfaction without the takeout sodium or oil.

~340 cal/serving·16g protein/serving·12 min (cold rice required — make Bone Broth Rice ahead)
4.7g P/100cal

~480 cal/serving·36g protein/serving·20 min
7.5g P/100cal

Parmesan Corn Chex Snap Peas

Sweet snap pea pop + nutty aged Parmigiano crunch + crispy Corn Chex texture. The 2:1 chex-to-Parm ratio is the move — more crunch, less density.

~80 cal/serving·1g protein/serving·5 min prep + 20 min bake
1.3g P/100cal

Crisp Sweet Gem + tangy yogurt Caesar + smoky fajita chicken + crunchy Hot & Spicy chips + Parmesan-jalapeño finisher. Restaurant-craveable, weeknight-fast.

Hot Dog Chili Base

Smoky beef-forward chili, tangy Dijon + Worcestershire, deep tomato-paste umami, bone-broth body. No beans. Thick enough to cling to a bun.

~175 cal/serving·22g protein/serving·5 min prep + 25 min cook
12.6g P/100cal
